name: Pinky Ponky 3 - Battle Lover
original_name: ぴんきぃぽんきぃ３ ばとるらばぁ
source:
The gameplay system of the third game in the Pinky Ponky series is identical to that of the original: the player character goes through five encounters with young women with the goal of eventually having sex with them. The gameplay consists of selecting dialogue choices and occasional actions, trying to raise the girl's satisfaction meter and not lead a scenario to a premature end. The situations are somewhat more exotic than in the previous two games - rather than focusing on conventional dating it depicts less common situations such as appeasing an angry female policeman or protecting a girl from a lecherous passer-by.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/58838/pinky-ponky-dai-3-shu-battle-lovers/]MobyGames[/url]]

Scenarios:
1. ナンパグルメロード (starring Hiromi)
2. 婦人警官は拳銃がお好き！？ (starring 南　陽子)
3. ふたまたは大変 (starring Miharu and Aiko)
4. 世界中の女は俺のもの
5. さわやかテニスライフ (starring Iwako and Kyouko)
